title: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
summary_full: Moody's said AI spending is forcing even the world's most cash-rich corporations to lean heavily on debt, stock sales and off-balance-sheet moves.
summary_public: Moody's said AI spending is forcing even the world's most cash-rich corporations to lean heavily on debt, stock sales and off-balance-sheet moves.
